title: Item comparison text overlaps background panel
description: When comparing two long-named weapons the second description runs into the border and becomes unreadable.

title: State indicator contradicts active filter
description: The list correctly hides completed tasks, yet the tiny icon beside the filter looks exactly the same before and after I switch it.

title: Old binding remains on help overlay
description: After rebinding dodge, the tutorial overlay still tells me to press the original keyboard key.

title: Companion fails to resume path after teleport
description: Fast travelling with my pet brings us both to the new zone, but the pet will no longer follow movement commands.

title: Ordinary resource satisfies rare recipe requirement
description: The crafting menu lists an unusual gem as essential; I can finish the recipe with a common material instead.

title: Extra loot appears after moving bag
description: Dragging a stack between quick slots sometimes leaves a copy of the item in the original position.

title: Text input lags in a large inventory
description: The search box receives each keystroke late only when a character has filled nearly all their storage slots.

title: Trade completed twice after timeout retry
description: The trade page times out and I hit retry; the exchange is recorded two times in the transaction history.

title: Co-op quest completion not shared
description: Our team finishes the objective, but one teammate still has an incomplete quest flag.

title: Typed communication stops after leadership changes
description: The group changes leaders mid-session. We can still speak over microphones but new messages I type never reach the others.

title: Shared object remains closed to guest
description: The team leader opens the passage and walks through; on my joined client the same passage is still sealed.

title: Movement noise remains when standing still
description: After stopping the character, a repeated scraping footstep noise keeps looping until I move again.

title: Enemy audio appears on wrong headphone
description: An attack approaches from the right side, although its sound is much louder in the left ear.
